NewsProperties.Description:
A new era begins for Sordland and it holds many economic questions that will need to be answered by President Rayne.

Our top economic analysts with consultation from the National Business Council have released a comprehensive report on the performance of the past twenty years. A certain section of the report stands out: the last two four-year plans of the planned doctrine created a budget deficit and a clear reduction of the industrial production output. This was specifically due to mismanagement and inefficient bureaucracy.

The year on year growth, budget balance and production index values indicate that the two most productive consecutive years had been when the privatization programme of Alphonso began in 1949. Our editorial team with the help of experts like Mikail Aven and Edith Agnoc have come to the conclusion that the recession was not actually caused by Alphonsonomics but by the drastic obstructions of state executives hindering the plan.

President Rayne must take the advice of planned economy proponents around him with a pinch of salt, otherwise he could find himself in the same spot of Tarquin Soll in the mid 40’s.
NewsProperties.Title: End Sollonomics!

NewsProperties.Description:
President Anton Rayne has been sworn into duty in a great ceremony in Holsord. Thousands have attended the ceremony where President Rayne has met with his supporters for the first time after his election.

In his inauguration, Rayne spoke of unity, bringing focus on 'people’s right for a free and prosperous life.' 'For many generations, this country and its long history have kept us tied to an idea, the idea of unity' said the new President before he went on to start his first day in the Maroon Palace.
NewsProperties.Title: Rayne Spoke of Unity

NewsProperties.Description:
After the recent successful mega-infrastructure projects from United Contana and Valgsland the world is warming up to the idea as a source of growth and employment. But is there any truth to this success?

Our investment analysis indicates that infrastructure investments can be fruitful in the short-term but even more so in the long-term especially if they focus on linking economic nodes that business logistics depend on. This is however the first step, the crux of the matter is diversification of investment where the government supports employment and growth. It is key to help private businesses with government contracts, tax breaks and political support in order to create a self-sufficient and dynamic economy.

The government's role in Sordland should be to integrate to the world economy and reap the benefits of global trade. Economic growth and income inequality in this country won't be fixed otherwise.
NewsProperties.Title: Restructure the Infrastructure?

NewsProperties.Description: The long-stalled Campaign Bill has once again taken centre stage in the Grand National Assembly. The bill, first proposed during the Alphonso Presidency, had been put on hold due to the 1953 election but has now been resurrected under President Anton Rayne. The proposed amendments ensure a more proportional allocation of public funds, more accurately reflecting a party's influence within the legislative body.
NewsProperties.Title: Campaign Bill: Fair Representation in the Assembly

NewsProperties.Description:
President Anton Rayne has been elected 4th President of Sordland in the 7th Sordish elections. The United Sordland Party has won the election on Sunday with just over 37 percent of the vote, while Frens Ricter, the leader of the People’s Freedom and Justice Party, could gain just over 20 percent.

Kesaro Kibener, the head of the right-wing National Front Party, is in third place with just over 11 percent.

The Communist Party of Sordland and the Workers Party of Bludia both won just below 10 percent of the vote, failing to pass the 10 percent election threshold.

The new term begins with the opposition of PFJP and NFP under the USP government. The unrepresented votes below the threshold resulted in the USP taking 52 percent of the seats in the Grand National Assembly, giving them the lawmaking power. The new seat numbers have been finalized as follows: USP 130, PFJP 70, NFP 40 and Independents 10.
NewsProperties.Title: The New Assembly Begins Duty

NewsProperties.Description:
How many times will people fall for the same trap? We’ve seen this before with Colonel Soll, who supposedly saved this country and brought stability in times of chaos. His stability, however, meant a life of oppression. Any opposing voices were silenced and many were persecuted. Next was Alphonso, who was elected as the liberal reformer to bring change to the USP and Sordland. Seeing his unfortunate inability, his own cabinet resigned.

As the third USP candidate becomes president, it is high time to realise that real change won't come from their party.
NewsProperties.Title: Another USP President

NewsProperties.Description:
The new President has been sworn into office by the Chief Justice Orso Hawker. Another great win for the USP and Anton Rayne, who managed to get 37% of the general vote.

The first congratulations came from Kesaro Kibener of the National Front Party, which finished third in the electoral race and entered the Assembly. The runner up of the general vote, the PFJP, didn't concede until the last minute, but the results were clear since several hours in.

Thousands of supporters have gathered in the streets of Lachaven chanting campaign slogans, waving flags and displaying USP party banners to display unwavering support to the newly elected president. The public mood is very positive in the city from all accounts on the ground. The city is celebrating that a Lachavener has become the President of Sordland.
NewsProperties.Title: President Anton Rayne

NewsProperties.Description:
As a result of his recent Agnolian visit, President Rayne and Prime Minister Van Hoorten have made a joint announcement that Sordland and Agnolia will enter an alliance.

The ever changing political landscape of Eastern Merkopa is about to change again. The effects of this alliance, in the grander scheme, will mean an increased trade and more importantly, military deterrent against the foes of the two countries. This is especially important following the heightened tensions in between Agnolia and Valgsland.

President Rayne’s Agnolia visit has certainly been fruitful for Sordland so far.
NewsProperties.Title: New Alliance In Eastern Merkopa

NewsProperties.Description:
Federation of Anrakan Isles, a collection of strategically located islands between the continents of Merkopa and Contana, is positioning itself as a significant buffer zone and global trade power amid escalating tensions between United Contana and Arcasia.

Anraka's naval strength has been a key factor in maintaining its influence in the region. With a powerful fleet protecting its maritime borders, the federation has managed to establish and maintain open trade routes, even amidst the ongoing confrontations between United Contana and Arcasia. This has enabled Anraka to attract business from both countries, positioning itself as a neutral ground for global trade and economic cooperation.
NewsProperties.Title: Anraka Emerges as Buffer Zone and Global Trade Power

NewsProperties.Description:
Dwight Walker has announced the first successful Arcasian intercontinental ballistic missile test which was conducted at a military test site at the Nuam Atoll in the middle of the Oseana. The fired missile codenamed Missile-4 flew several thousands of kilometers towards the direction of United Contana before crashing down at sea close to the abandoned radioactive Rostov island.

The missile test indicates that Arcasia wants to send a message to United Contana about island bases in the middle of the Oseana while displaying that the Arcasian military technology has advanced.

Will Arcasia be able to catch up to United Contana in face of the growing contentious situation between the superpowers?
NewsProperties.Title: Arcasia Fires the M-4 ICBM

NewsProperties.Description:
In the midst of a politically unstable situation in Marabone, the largest Arcasian private military corporation, Palantor Security Solutions (PSS), has deployed its forces to the resource-rich nation. Sources reveal that the Arcasian PMC has been contracted by several multinational corporations to secure and extract valuable natural resources amidst the chaos.

Marabone, a country in the continent of Rika, has been grappling with internal strife and weak governance, leading to a power vacuum. This has opened doors for foreign interests to exploit the situation and extract the abundant resources, such as oil, minerals, and rare earth metals, present within Marabone's borders.

Reports suggest that PSS has already established several forward operating bases near key resource extraction sites, raising concerns about the long-term implications of this move on Marabone's sovereignty.
NewsProperties.Title: Arcasian PMC Descends on Marabone Amid Resource Extraction Controversy

NewsProperties.Description:
Patricio Alvarez, the Prime Minister of Lespia, on his scheduled visit to the Republic of Agnolia to meet Prime Minister Van Hoorten, had failed to get off the plane when it landed on the Staalport International Airport. It is believed that he has been “too drunk” to get off the plane.

The assembled dignitaries waited at the airplane at the scheduled hour but Alvarez's plane did not land. Airport officials reported that it was circling over Staalport. After circling for two hours the plane landed but Alvarez did not come out. Lespian officials informed Van Hoorten that Alvarez was unwell and that the foreign minister would join the meeting instead.
NewsProperties.Title: Circling Over Staalport

NewsProperties.Description:
Under the leadership of Galmland's second female leader, Brighde Halvorsdatir, the ideological dispute between Galmland and Valgsland has intensified. Halvorsdatir's government has been actively promoting the development and implementation of the Galmish Manifesto, a unique interpretation of Karlos Marcias' communist theory. The country has been pushing this agenda to other CSP countries, garnering support and building alliances in an effort to strengthen their position in the region.

However, internal factions backed by Valgslandian Socialism and United Contanan Malenyevism pose a significant challenge to Halvorsdatir's government. These factions are working to undermine the Galmish Manifesto and weaken Galmland's influence among its allies. As tensions escalate, both nations find themselves locked in a fierce ideological battle, with potentially significant consequences for regional stability and cooperation.
NewsProperties.Title: Ideological Dispute Between Galmland and Valgsland Intensifies

NewsProperties.Description:
With a surprising move, President Rayne has announced that Sordland will recognize Heljiland as Agnolian territory after his visit to the Agnolian PM Van Hoorten, sending ripples around the world.

Heljiland is an island that has been long disputed in between Agnolia and Valgsland due to its strategic position. Following the Agnolian drilling operation in the previous months, the situation has escalated and the warships got engaged in a stand-off over the international waters.

Regardless of the return value for this move, one thing is for certain. Actively siding with Agnolia will unfortunately mean opposing Valgsland in the current dangerous climate.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Recognizes Heljiland As Agnolian Territory

NewsProperties.Description:
Earlier this week, the leader of United Contana and the head of CSP, Leon "Malenyev" Chavatangakwunua, declared polio to be a public health crisis. He urged the ally countries within the pact to immediately start preventative procedures, to stop the virus from spreading, and hastily apply the vaccine, which he has made available for the entire world.

President Dwight Walker has likewise made a public statement that countries in the ATO should swiftly administer the vaccine to stop the disease from spreading to highly populated areas.

With the plague spreading rapidly, especially in Wehlen and Sordland, causing millions of death and even more infection throughout the world, it is encouraged that all countries, regardless of ideology, come together and fight against the pandemic.
NewsProperties.Title: International Polio Crisis

NewsProperties.Description:
President Walker’s Sordland visit bore fruit as President Rayne has announced that Sordland will be joining the ranks of ATO.

The historic moment has been welcomed warmly by the member states of ATO as they congratulated Sordland. President Rayne’s Lespian counterpart, Prime Minister Alvarez has called Sordland’s joining to ATO, ‘the best thing to happen in Eastern Merkopa in the last century.’

Over the span of the next couple of years, Sordland will economically, militarily, and diplomatically integrate with the rest of the pact. Although the membership comes with a myriad of responsibilities, the changes will improve Sordland as a whole in almost every aspect.

On the other side of the world, the leader of CSP, Chairman Malenyev called the Sordland’s ATO membership ‘a threat to the stability of the world’ while Chancellor Hegel refrained from making a comment.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Joins ATO

NewsProperties.Description:
Chairman Malenyev’s Sordland visit bore fruit as President Rayne has announced that Sordland will be joining the ranks of CSP.

The historic moment has been welcomed warmly by the member states of CSP as they congratulated Sordland. President Rayne’s Valgslandian counterpart, Chancellor Hegel has called Sordland’s joining to CSP, ‘the best thing to happen in Eastern Merkopa in the last century.’

Over the span of the next couple of years, Sordland will economically, militarily, and diplomatically integrate with the rest of the pact. Although the membership comes with a myriad of responsibilities, the changes will improve Sordland as a whole in almost every aspect.

On the other side of the world, the leader of ATO, President Walker called Sordland’s CSP membership ‘a threat to the stability of the world’ while Prime Minister Alvarez refrained from making a comment.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Joins CSP

NewsProperties.Description: Prime Minister Alvarez has condemned the military alliance between Sordland and Valgsland, calling it a “great threat for the democracies of Merkopa.” He announced that the Lespian government is readying new sanctions against Sordland, which will be aimed at crippling the Sordish economy.
NewsProperties.Title: Lespia Trade Sanctions Against Sordland

NewsProperties.Description:
According to a report from the Alliance of Nations, immediately after the occupation, Valgslandian forces started building missile silos and they brought in vehicles that are suspected to carry United Contanan missiles that are capable of reaching Western Merkopa.

Agnolian leader Van Hoorten claimed that Valgsland is planning to install nuclear missiles on the island. He said that Agnolia will not allow Valgsland to settle on Heljiland.

Agnolian forces did not react apart from two air raids since the invasion and it is unknown if the conflict will be concluded officially any time soon.
NewsProperties.Title: Missiles On Heljiland

NewsProperties.Description:
Following his latest TV interview, President Rayne seems to be successful so far in receiving the backing of the international community. Led by Sordland’s request, OMEC has decided to expel Rumburg from the Eastern Merkopan economic forum.

Undoubtedly a drastic and surprising resolution, this move will sever the long-strained economic ties of Rumburg with the organisation. Queen Beatrice Livingston refrained from making any comments yet.
NewsProperties.Title: OMEC Announces Expulsion of Rumburg

NewsProperties.Description:
President Smolak has declared the start of ‘Operation Bear Trap’ against the separatist militant group that plagues northern Wehlen, the Bludish Freedom Front. Rumburg, Agnolia and Lespia has condemned the mobilisation order, citing the war crimes committed during the previous assault against the Bludish people while Sordland announced that the Sordish Armed Forces will also join the operation.

Previously, President Smolak has officially invited and allowed the Sordish Armed Forces to enter Wehlen for a joint operation. As part of a series of assaults against the BFF, Wehlen was mostly alone in the international theatre in the past years. This time around however, Wehlen has finally found an ally in the region thanks to President Rayne: Sordland.
NewsProperties.Title: ‘OPERATION BEAR TRAP’ BEGINS

NewsProperties.Description:
President Smolak has declared the start of ‘Operation Bear Trap’ against the separatist militant group that plagues northern Wehlen, the Bludish Freedom Front. Rumburg, Agnolia and Lespia has condemned the mobilisation order, citing the war crimes committed during the previous assault against the Bludish people while Sordland has not made any comments on the matter.

Watchtower of Human Rights said that they will be following the developments closely for any infractions on human rights violations.
NewsProperties.Title: ‘OPERATION BEAR TRAP’ BEGINS

NewsProperties.Description:
MOUSTAPAL - Prime Minister Reza Ngoda of Qinal hosted a crucial anti-piracy summit, bringing together leaders and representatives from the Xinan Economic Cooperation (XEC) and other Xinan nations, such as Xelina, Narashima, and Fenncao. The conference aimed to address the alarming rise in piracy incidents in the region and focus on developing a united and coordinated response to protect maritime interests and combat piracy funded by certain ATO nations and private military companies.

During the summit, Ngoda emphasized the importance of fostering cooperation and solidarity among the participating nations. "Piracy poses a severe threat to our economies, maritime trade, and regional stability. It is essential for us to join forces and tackle this menace head-on, working together for the safety and well-being of our citizens," Ngoda stated.

The summit led to the signing of the "Moustapal Declaration," which included the establishment of joint naval patrols, enhanced intelligence sharing, and capacity-building initiatives for the nations involved. Additionally, representatives stressed the need to address the root causes of piracy, such as poverty, unemployment, and weak governance in some of the affected nations, as well as concerns over piracy being funded by certain ATO countries and PMCs.
NewsProperties.Title: Qinal's Anti-Piracy Summit: United Efforts to Combat Rising Piracy and Maritime Security Concerns

NewsProperties.Description:
Queen of Rumburg, Beatrice Livingston brought up the Estord Incident of the 15-Day War, igniting the forgotten century-old debate of Sordish war crimes. She spoke about the need for peace and change in Eastern Merkopa and that the way forward can only be walked if past atrocities are finally settled.

Queen Livingston claimed that the Sordish Army in 1870 had massacred ethnic Rums with plans of committing genocide. “Sordland still hasn’t claimed any responsibility for their past war crimes,” said the queen and demanded reparations to be paid.
NewsProperties.Title: Queen Beatrice Demands Reparations For Century Old Alleged War Crimes

NewsProperties.Description:
Our foreign policy analysts who are reviewing the recent aggressive military and diplomatic developments of Rumburg have come to the conclusion that it is highly likely that Rumburg will keep trying to push further south, threatening the territories of Sordland, Wehlen and possibly Agnolia.

The War of Broken Wills many decades ago was just the beginning, Rumburg seems to be on a quest to secure all strategic resources in East Merkopa.
NewsProperties.Title: Rumburg Coming South?

NewsProperties.Description:
With an unexpected move, President Rayne has accepted the decades-long demands of Rumburg and seceded the two Sordish cities, Estord and Narbel to Rumburg.

Whether this was an attempt to maintain peace or a display of weakness on Sordland’s part, one thing is certain. President Rayne will be in trouble at home. Sordish citizens, especially in Estord and Narbel cried foul and many more are joining them in their protests against the government.

President Rayne’s seat seems shaky at best for now.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Secedes Estord and Narbel

NewsProperties.Description:
Following Rumburg’s demands for reparations from Sordland, the tensions have increased dramatically between the two countries. Yesterday, a Sordish warplane has been shot by the Rumburg anti-air systems and all of the pilots onboard have been killed.

As per the information from Rumburg, the Sordish warplane has trespassed into Rumburgian airspace whereas Sordish military reports that the plane was inside Sordish borders when it was shot. The international community is unclear of the certainty of the reports from both sides.

Thankfully, the Sordish administration approached the incident calmly and established a peace line to avert war between the two countries. President Rayne has been commended internationally for his efforts to de-escalate the situation and maintain peace.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Creates Peace Line to Avert War

NewsProperties.Description:
Following Rumburg’s demands for reparations from Sordland, the tensions have increased dramatically between the two countries. Yesterday, a Sordish warplane has been shot by the Rumburg anti-air systems and all of the pilots onboard have been killed.

As per the information from Rumburg, the Sordish warplane has trespassed into Rumburgian airspace whereas Sordish military reports that the plane was inside Sordish borders when it was shot. The international community is unclear of the certainty of the reports from both sides.

Immediately after the incident, Sordland retaliated by sending their warplanes into the Rumburg airspace and destroying a Rumburgian jet. The tensions between Rumburg and Sordland continue to increase as the largest troop deployments in the last decade began in Eastern Merkopa.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Shoots Down Rumburg Warplane in Retaliation

NewsProperties.Description:
Following Rumburg’s demands for reparations from Sordland, the tensions have increased dramatically between the two countries. Yesterday, a Sordish warplane has been shot by the Rumburg anti-air systems and all of the pilots onboard have been killed.

As per the information from Rumburg, the Sordish warplane has trespassed into Rumburgian airspace whereas Sordish military reports that the plane was inside Sordish borders when it was shot. The international community is unclear of the certainty of the reports from both sides.

Immediately after the incident, Sordland has started ramping up its military production, triggering fears of a war. The tensions between Rumburg and Sordland continue to increase as the largest troop deployments in the last decade began in Eastern Merkopa.
NewsProperties.Title: War Coming?

NewsProperties.Description:
During the Alliance of Nations session, President Rayne has claimed that Rumburg possessed nuclear weapons. Today, the investigation committee tasked by AN has found evidence that President Rayne was in fact saying the truth. Rumburg has nuclear weapons. So what does this mean for Eastern Merkopa?

In the region, Rumburg has always been one of the strongest military powers and also one of the most threatening which secures them the position of being a key player. Possession of nuclear weapons by such a country not only threatens their neighbours and long-time rivals, Sordland, but also nations that are farther away from their immediate reach. Rumburg’s new status as a nuclear power will make them a force to be reckoned with.

Balance of the world is about to change once again.
NewsProperties.Title: Rumburg Possesses Nuclear Weapons!

NewsProperties.Description:
As per the joint announcement made by Rumburgian and Sordish foreign ministries, a peace summit will soon be held in Thornbourgh, capital of Rumburg.

With the trade deal as the first step, President Rayne and Queen Beatrice Livingston has indeed proven that they are on the path to peace and prosperity in Eastern Merkopa.

A new alliance appears to be on the horizon for the two neighbours.
NewsProperties.Title: Eastern Merkopan Peace Summit

NewsProperties.Description:
Troop deployments and movements near the Sordland-Rumburg border have increased tenfold over the previous weeks signaling a potential hot conflict brewing. The recent nationwide mobilization order also proves that Sordland is preparing their defenses against Rumburg.

Regional neighbours and Alliance of Nations urged calm in the region with the exception of President Smolak.

For now, peace in Eastern Merkopa is hanging by a thread that is almost about to snap.
NewsProperties.Title: Rumburg Prepares for an Invasion

NewsProperties.Description:
ATO Leader President Dwight Walker and CSP Leader Leon "Malenyev" Chavatangakwunua made history yesterday with a joint announcement to address the threat of Rumburg.

The declaration signalled sanctions on Rumburg if the threatening moves continued in Eastern Merkopa. During the speech, they also thanked Sordland for the efforts to bring more attention to the issue.

Overnight, Rumburg’s economy has taken a strong hit due to the sanctions of trade. President Rayne’s strategy to isolate Rumburg has been proven to be working.
NewsProperties.Title: ATO and CSP Signals Sanctions on Rumburg

NewsProperties.Description:
Troop deployments and movements near the Sordland-Rumburg border have increased tenfold over the previous weeks signaling a potential hot conflict brewing. The recent nationwide mobilization order also proves that Sordland is preparing for a massive war against Rumburg.

Regional neighbours and Alliance of Nations urged calm in the region with the exception of President Smolak. For now, peace in Eastern Merkopa is hanging by a thread that is almost about to snap.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Prepares for an Invasion

NewsProperties.Description:
Rumburg and Sordland made history yesterday when they ratified a trade deal, the first in decades between the two countries.

The trade deal will bring the Sordish natural gas pipeline to Rumburg in addition to a cost reduction of 30%. In return, Rumburg will provide licenses for KA-74 production, hinting at further cooperation. This deal is certainly a big step forward towards peace in Eastern Merkopa. Could we perhaps see an end to the soured relationship between Sordland and Rumburg?

With the current direction President Rayne is bringing Sordland to, we might even see a new alliance form in the next decade.
NewsProperties.Title: Rumburg and Sordland Sign Trade Deal

NewsProperties.Description:
Sordish government has officially signed a new economic deal and a military pact with Lespia, which brings the two economies closer through an economic partnership agreement, as well as their militaries with a new military alliance.

The Sordland-Lespia Alliance was made official by President Rayne and Prime Minister Alvarez in Perla yesterday. The deal is tailored to benefit both economies with big benefits to Sordish and Lespian businesses. It includes a strong commitment from Lespia to support Sordland with Lespian capital. It will also bring the militaries of both countries closer together, through joint military training and intelligence sharing. According to the pact, both countries will join each other in any defensive wars.

This signing marks a new period of close relations between Sordland and Lespia, which will see two like-minded democracies work together as allies.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland-Lespia Pact

NewsProperties.Description:
President Rayne has announced that Sordland will recognize Valgsland’s claim on the island of Heljiland, after his meeting with Chancellor Hegel, sending ripples around Eastern Merkopa and beyond.

Heljiland is an island that has been long disputed between Agnolia and Valgsland due to its strategic position. Following the bloody conflict in Heljiland, Valgsland has been increasing its presence on Agnolia and started to pose a threat to peace in the region.

Sordland’s decision to support Valgsland may be the sign of an incoming conflict. Regardless, now Agnolia stands alone in Eastern Merkopa against two major regional powers.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Recognizes Heljiland As Valgslandian Territory

NewsProperties.Description:
Sordish government has officially signed a new economic deal and a military pact with Valgsland, which brings the two economies closer through an economic partnership agreement, as well as their militaries with a new military alliance.

The Sordland-Valgsland Alliance was made official by President Rayne and Chancellor Hegel in Haelm yesterday. The deal is tailored to benefit both economies with big benefits to Sordish and Valgslandian businesses. It will also bring the militaries of both countries closer together, through joint military training and intelligence sharing. According to the pact, both countries will join each other in any defensive wars.

This signing marks a new period of close relations between Sordland and Valgsland, which will see two regional powers work together as allies.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland-Valgsland Pact

NewsProperties.Description:
The eyes of the world turned towards the Gulf of Rika when the Arcasian 3rd Fleet and the United Contanan Rika Fleet met at a huge escalation of tensions between the two superpowers. The confrontation was triggered by the Arcasia-led coup of the left-leaning Nibiyan leader Atanur Ladafe. The leader was democratically elected twice under the system but overthrown by a nationalist colonel named Zedeyu Ogrunwa.

Upon losing a key ally in the central part of the world, United Contana was pushed to the brink and blocked the gulf where nearly half of the global trade flows. This resulted in a massive disruption of global trade and commerce which rippled across all nations. Arcasia responded with tariffs on Contanan goods and in return United Contana temporarily embargoed all Arcasian goods for the entire CSP alliance.
NewsProperties.Title: Confrontation in Rika Causes Trade War

NewsProperties.Description:
Kyow, United Contana - United Contana recently hosted a massive congress, bringing together representatives from all states to address the state of the union and discuss a significant political decision concerning the concept of permanent revolution.

The congress, held in the federation's capital, featured the unique traditions and customs of various states, including Kontania, Kyow, Kaidu, Zolatec, Auzatl, Yurzestan, Slovarya, Chimaltenango, and Quinaulta. Participants expressed pride in their heritage while demonstrating a strong sense of unity under the governance of the Communist Party, led by Chairman Leon "Malenyev" Chavatangakwunua.

During the congress, Chairman Malenyev proposed the "Revolutionary Destiny" doctrine, a policy aimed at promoting the idea of permanent revolution and supporting social revolutions in nearby states with early-stage capitalism. Senators from each state participated in a vote to determine the future course of the nation, ultimately passing the doctrine and signaling a new era of international involvement for United Contana.
NewsProperties.Title: United Contana's Congress Addresses State of the Union and Revolutionary Expansion

NewsProperties.Description: Chairman Leon "Malenyev" Chavatangakwunua addressed the world announcing the second successful satellite launch from Rostonur Air Base which has now reached low earth orbit. The chairman praised the scientists and the UCOSM that allowed the country to reach space a second time. The functionality of the satellite was confirmed when radio contact was established after deployment.
NewsProperties.Title: Second Contanan Satellite in Space!

NewsProperties.Description:
HAELM, VALGSLAND - Building upon the foundations of Valgslandian Socialism, inspired by Emmerich Hegel's revolutionary ideas, labor unions are spearheading the next phase of decentralized economic growth and worker empowerment in Valgsland. This unique form of socialism, emphasizing a federal, economic organization of society, continues to reshape the nation's political and economic landscape.

The Valgsland Workers' Cooperative, a successful example of Valgslandian Socialism in practice, has led to a remarkable 17% increase in productivity and an impressive 33% rise in worker satisfaction. Encouraged by these results, calls for the expansion of decentralized structures across various sectors of the economy have gained momentum.

In light of these successes, Valgsland's Minister of Labor, Frida Albrechtsson, recently unveiled a new initiative in Haelm aimed at further expanding infrastructure, promoting scientific and technological advancements. "We believe that the principles of Valgslandian Socialism offer a sustainable and equitable path for our nation's future," Albrechtsson stated during a press conference in Stahlort.

As Valgsland moves forward with Emmerich Hegel's vision of a decentralized, egalitarian society, the nation is solidifying its position as a leader in socialist thought and policy-making, both at home and abroad. With labor unions at the forefront of this movement, the ongoing development of Valgslandian Socialism offers a promising blueprint for other nations seeking to implement similar reforms.
NewsProperties.Title: Valgsland Labor Unions Drive Further Decentralized Economic Growth, Empower Workers

NewsProperties.Description:
This morning, Valgslandian forces has occupied Heljiland with only a small amount of casualties when the forces of Heljiland surrendered after the invasion that was executed yesterday.

After the surrender, Chancellor Hegel had reclaimed Heljiland as part of Valgsland and described the events as the triumph of freedom and reversal of historical injustices.

Agnolian leader Van Hoorten condemned the invasion, and the AN, for leaving Agnolia alone and not interfering. “This was a drastic first step of Valgslandian and Malenyevist invasion in Eastern Merkopa and I’m warning those who allowed them to do this, this is how liberty dies,” he said. Agnolian Navy has also returned back to Staalport after a brief firefight with the Valgslandian forces.
NewsProperties.Title: Valgsland Occupies Heljiland

NewsProperties.Description:
The recent Arcasian elections have come to an end, with incumbent Dwight Walker narrowly winning re-election against Charles Devereaux of the Reformist Union party. Devereaux's campaign was notably sponsored by the prominent private military corporation, Cerberus International. With a margin of just 5 percent, Walker's victory has brought a sense of stability to Ventrie City following a tumultuous campaign season marked by political assassinations and corporate meddling.

Walker's re-election has been attributed to his successful efforts in lifting a significant portion of the population out of poverty during his previous term. However, despite these achievements, Arcasia's economy has recently shown signs of stagnation. Experts argue that the slowdown may be due to the high expenditures associated with the ATO alliance and the ongoing cold war against United Contana.

Adding to the complexity of the political landscape, tensions have risen between Rumburgian migrants and Arcasian citizens. Walker, who has Rumburgian heritage, has faced criticism and suspicion from some segments of the population. Despite these challenges, Walker has emphasized the importance of unity and inclusion in his political agenda.

In his victory speech, President Walker, of the New Democratic Concord, acknowledged the challenges ahead and vowed to work toward a more inclusive and prosperous society, while maintaining Arcasia's core principles.
NewsProperties.Title: Walker Wins Arcasian Election, Stabilizing Ventrie City Amid Economic Stagnation

NewsProperties.Description:
WRACLAWITZ, WEHLEN - Wehzek President Wiktor Smolak on Thursday criticised the Lespian government for bringing Arcasian soldiers ‘close to the borders of Wehlen’.

Last month, Prime Minister Alvarez and President Walker agreed on the construction of several military bases in Lespia that would station ATO soldiers. With the arrival of the first Arcasian soldiers to Lespia this week, Wehlen’s stance has become increasingly hostile.

In his speech on Thursday, Smolak said, ‘President Walker has succeeded in spreading Arcasian imperialism to Eastern Merkopa, which will have consequences for every one of us in the region.’ 

‘ATO is clearly expanding its influence in our region using Lespia. We must be careful,’ said President Smolak, warning the neighbouring nations of Agnolia and Sordland to be prepared for future crises.
NewsProperties.Title: Smolak Condemns Arcasian Soldiers in Lespia

NewsProperties.Description:
WRACLAWITZ, WEHLEN - President Smolak has announced that the city of Vernen has been put under curfew along with seven other towns in the northeast of the country. The Wehzek army has deployed specially trained military forces in the to combat the militant organization known as the Bludish Freedom Front.

Wehlen has increased its efforts in fighting terrorism, with aerial campaigns and ground operations targeting BFF militants and their hidden bases. This operation will surely have consequences for the region, particularly for the neighbouring countries of Lespia, Rumburg and particularly Sordland, which has a large population of Bludish people living inside its borders.
NewsProperties.Title: Wehlen Deploying Special Forces To Vernen

NewsProperties.Description:
A wave of targeted political assassinations struck Ventrie City’s Financial District, claiming the lives of one key campaign staffer and one local district politician preceding Arcasia’s decisive vote. A coordinated drive-by shooting and small explosive detonation aimed at Charles Devereaux’s team heightened fears of election disruption. Palantor Security Solutions aided Arcasian Police at rally sites, while Cerberus International reinforced key transit hubs with rapid-response and surveillance units.

The election comes amid slowing growth, rising military spending, and mounting pressure on working-class communities. President Dwight Walker’s pro-market agenda faces resistance from voters backing Devereaux’s platform for welfare expansion and public oversight. Debates over inequality, migration, and privatized power have polarized the electorate and drawn attention from observers wary of Contana-aligned interference.

In a televised address, Walker condemned the killings, vowed justice, and urged citizens to uphold constitutional values.
NewsProperties.Title: Turmoil Strikes Ventrie City

NewsProperties.Description:
In a stunning development, former President and current Chairman of Gasom, Ewald Alphonso, has announced his departure from the exclusive Lotherberg Group. His decision has been fueled by a growing disillusionment with the interests of the secretive organization. Alphonso has been quoted saying he's intent on charting his own course, away from Lotherberg. 

However, this abrupt exit from the Group, only a few months after his defeat in the 1953 elections, marks another political setback for the man who led Sordland into its deepest recession back in 1951.
NewsProperties.Title: Alphonso Abandons Lotherberg's Exclusive Conclave

NewsProperties.Description:
A new prototype for the first pocket radio was displayed by the Arcasian electronics company Armadine Industries in Ventrie City. After six years of research the engineers behind the pocket transistor radio have revealed that the material science questions regarding the composites have been solved. The company is now filing the patents for the product.

The CEO of Armadine Arron Bridges is predicting an IPO at VCSE in the upcoming years. In a bid to raise further investment Mr. Bridges has called for all venture capitalists who believe in the future of science and technology in the marketplace to invest in the company.

The President of Arcasia Dwight Walker praised the bright minds of Arcasian engineers following the announcement and called for further technological advancements for the military industrial complex.
NewsProperties.Title: Armadine Industries Pioneering Electronics

NewsProperties.Description:
As the Rayne administration starts its first term, there is a question in all of our heads. What will be the regional international trade policy?

Due to the strategic geopolitical location of Sordland, historically Agnolia and Wehlen have been natural trading partners. Depending on the direction of the Rayne administration, we think it is likely that a new trade deal will be brokered with at least one of these partners in the near term.

All in all, regardless of which trading partners the administration decides to go with, one thing is for sure. Regional trade will boost the ailing economy.

The real question is what does Valgsland or Lespia think about Sordland?
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland's Regional Trade

NewsProperties.Description:
In a recent twist to the Aureus offshore gas fields saga, the Kingdom of Rizia has strongly refuted the Grand Duchy of Pales' counterclaim. This development escalates last year's surprise move by Rizia, which asserted ownership based on historical records and longstanding ANDOR maritime agreements. The claim had initially put significant pressure on Pales and caused notable fluctuations in Merkopan energy markets.

The Grand Duchy of Pales, countering Rizia's assertions, had presented their own historical evidence and legal agreements to justify their exploitation rights. This counterclaim added fuel to the already intense dispute, drawing keen attention from across Merkopa and prompting offers of international mediation to prevent further escalation.

Despite the ongoing diplomatic efforts, the deadlock continues to unsettle the region's energy sector. Energy companies across Merkopa express growing concerns about operational disruptions and potential impacts on the region's energy supply. The persistence of this dispute threatens not only immediate economic interests but also the long-term stability of energy markets.
NewsProperties.Title: Rizia Firmly Refutes Pales' Retort in Aureus Gas Fields Dispute

NewsProperties.Description:
The Campaign Finance Bill has been vetoed by President Rayne after its approval from the Grand National Assembly by majority vote on Friday following a three-hour debate.

Frens Ricter - who also objected to the funding package saying it contained too much unfairness in the allocation of the budget - also sought to delay proceedings by demanding a formal recorded vote, but was overruled. The bill passed the Assembly, but failed to become law by President Rayne’s decision.
NewsProperties.Title: President Vetoes Bill

NewsProperties.Description:
Speaker Gloria Tory said that a committee which includes all three political parties of the Assembly, has been formed for the preparation of potential changes to the constitution. The committee has been asked to submit a comprehensive report to find a solution for the current problematic state of affairs in the governmental institutions.

Tory said, 'USP wants to appeal to the people of Sordland to help in maintaining stability and order in the state.' The details of the committee regarding its actual topics or its members have not been clarified.
NewsProperties.Title: A Committee For Reforms

NewsProperties.Description:
The Campaign Finance Bill has been signed into law by President Rayne after the approval of the Grand National Assembly by majority vote on Friday following a three-hour debate.

Frens Ricter - who objected to the funding package saying it contained too much unfairness in the allocation of the budget - also sought to delay proceedings by demanding a formal recorded vote, but was overruled.

The new law brings small changes to the criteria for the allocation of the campaign budgets, and introduces no changes to the total amount of public funds reserved for the political parties which stands as 100 million SR.
NewsProperties.Title: Electoral Funding Reform

NewsProperties.Description:
A sudden fire broke out in the archives of the Holsord State University engulfing a significant part of the academic administration building. It was put out by the local firefighters after burning for 8 hours and ravaging through the historic library which housed many priceless documents.

Reporters on the scene have relayed that the event occurred in the evening with multiple staff of the faculty being transported to the hospital with severe burns but no deaths occurred. The rector Sander Navek immediately commented that the incident has damaged several academic works and employee records. “We might have lost the world or we might have lost Merkopa. We won't know until the day when we can enter the facility to evaluate.”.
NewsProperties.Title: Fire Strikes Holsord State University Archive

NewsProperties.Description:
President Anton Rayne has been sworn into duty in a great ceremony in Holsord. Thousands have attended the ceremony where President Rayne has met with his supporters for the first time after his election.

In his inauguration, Rayne spoke about change and hope, bringing focus on reforms. 'Together, we will bring prosperity and reform to our nation. It is a time of hope, it is a time of change,' said the new President before he went on to start his first day in the Maroon Palace.
NewsProperties.Title: Rayne Spoke of Change and Hope

NewsProperties.Description:
President Anton Rayne has been sworn into duty in a great ceremony in Holsord. Thousands have attended the ceremony where President Rayne has met with his supporters for the first time after his election.

In his inauguration, Rayne spoke about the current dire situation, bringing focus on the suffering of Sordish people. 'We are enduring economic hardship like never before, and today, our nation is falling apart,' said the new President before he went on to start his first day in the Maroon Palace.
NewsProperties.Title: Rayne Emphasized Sordland’s Dire Situation

NewsProperties.Description:
The Sordland Tourism and Cultural Preservation Act, currently under deliberation in the Grand National Assembly, is a shining beacon of hope. Aimed at enhancing the tourism appeal of Borin, Ribery, Lachaven, Anrica, and Benfi, the Act promises to position Sordland as a global tourist destination. 

As the nation grapples with economic hardship, the bill's potential to boost tourism and cultural preservation efforts provides a much-needed silver lining.
NewsProperties.Title: Tourism: A Beacon of Hope for Sordland

NewsProperties.Description:
A bill to change the criteria for the allocation of public funds to political parties is proposed by Representative Albin Clavin from the USP. The bill aims to change the criteria from the proportion of votes won in general elections to proportion of seats won by a political party in the Grand National Assembly. This would result in an increase of about 28 million SR to the governing United Sordland Party which will benefit the most from the proposed bill.

The new bill would give political parties an annual amount of 500.000 SR per Member of Assembly.
NewsProperties.Title: Support in Assembly Grows For Campaign Finance Bill

NewsProperties.Description: The Meteorological Institute has reported the record low temperature of minus 29 in the city of Uziren. A warning for frostbite has been issued in the cities of southern Bergia. People are advised not to go out unless they must due to the risk of frostbite. Schools are closed for this period.
NewsProperties.Title: Freezing Temperatures Recorded

NewsProperties.Description: As Sordland grapples with economic challenges, Gasom, one of the nation's largest corporations, has announced a freeze on new hires. The corporation, integral to Sordland's energy sector and a significant contributor to its economy, has yet to announce when it intends to lift the hiring freeze. While this development is a blow to the Sordish workforce, it's a reminder of the delicate state of our nation's economy.
NewsProperties.Title: Gasom Hires Freeze Amid Economic Strains

NewsProperties.Description:
Breaking News! Bernard Circas, a prominent independent MP known for his communist romanticism has been murdered leaving the Maroon Palace grounds after the inauguration ball of Anton Rayne.

Reports indicate a politically motivated assault by the far-right nationalists of the Young Sords. Shocking photographs have been leaked to the press showing blood dripped stairs of the Maroon Palace. We heavily condemn this sort of political violence, this is the very cycle the President must break with reforms.
NewsProperties.Title: Murder at the Palace!

NewsProperties.Description:
As the Sordish National League prepares to kick off its 1954-1955 season, the excitement and anticipation surrounding the league is greater than ever before. Football, once a minor pastime in Sordland, has steadily grown in popularity over the past decade, with the National League emerging as the premier platform for the country's top teams to showcase their skills and compete for the coveted championship title.

FC Gelsord, last season's champions, return with a core of experienced veterans, including star striker Hakon Brenner, who holds the top-scorer title of the league since 1952.

Meanwhile, FC Anrica have managed to add several new players to their lineup after new investments coming to the club, and is looking to bounce back after disappointing seasons and reclaim their spots as contenders for the championship.

While it's impossible to predict whether FC Gelsord will finally be bested this season, one thing is certain: the Sordish National League is slowly cementing itself as a force in the world of football, and the 1954-1955 season is sure to be a testament to the league's growing prestige and popularity.
NewsProperties.Title: SORDISH NATIONAL LEAGUE STARTS SEASON

NewsProperties.Description:
Ewald Alphonso, the once influential political figure and former President, has publicly severed ties with the influential Lotherberg Group. Frustrated by the Group's direction, Alphonso, the current Chairman of Gasom, is determined to steer his own path. Despite this apparent show of independence, one can't help but view his decision as a demonstration of a growing rift within Lotherberg. 

Alphonso's political failures including a devastating loss to President Anton Rayne in the 1953 elections and his triggering of the 1951 recession, cast a long shadow over this move.
NewsProperties.Title: Alphonso Ditches Lotherberg: A Sign of Discord

NewsProperties.Description:
A new bill that further expands on the unfairness of our election system has been approved by the Grand National Assembly and was later vetoed by President Rayne. Rayne deserves credit for crushing the undemocratic proposal, even though it came from his own party and would have benefitted himself.

The bill sought to change the rules of eligibility of the public funds that are reserved for every political party in Sordland. It eliminates every party from eligibility to the funds, apart from the three that are currently in the Assembly.

The insane proposal would have also resulted in the governing United Sordland Party’s share from the funds to double. Luckily, President Rayne showed us that he can go against his own party when it needs to be done.
NewsProperties.Title: Unfair Campaign Finance Bill Crushed

NewsProperties.Description:
The Holsord elite gathers for a lavish state ball. Many citizens in the country are uncertain about their own future but the state has no problems with wasting taxpayer's money right from the start.

We demand that these traditions of wasteful nature will become a thing of the past once the President settles in. The team here at the Radical will keep fighting for a better, more equal tomorrow for all.
NewsProperties.Title: Glamorous Inaugural Ball

NewsProperties.Description:
A new law that further expands on the unfairness of our election system has been approved by the Grand National Assembly and was signed into law by President Rayne.

The new law changes the rules of eligibility of the public funds that are reserved for every political party in Sordland. Previously, the funds were given on the basis of the number of votes in the general elections. With these changes, the funds will be given on the basis of the number of seats the political party holds, which eliminates every party apart from the three that are currently in the Assembly.

This insane law also results in the governing United Sordland Party’s share from the funds to double. As Anton Rayne’s presidency begins, we at The Radical, are already smelling the rot in Holsord.
NewsProperties.Title: USP Hijacks Elections

NewsProperties.Description:
A man in his 20s has been beaten with baseball bats in a paramilitary-style attack in Arvory. The man claims to have been attacked because of his ethnic background as an Agno-Sordish citizen. 

He was approached during a walk at the park by a group of right-wing extremists who are suspected of being regulars at the local National Front Party office. The group inflicted injuries to his legs and arms, police said.

The man was brought to the hospital after making his way to a nearby property. The Police Service of Arvory said it was a 'brutal attack for which there is no justification'.

'There is no place for attacks such as this in our society,' said Eric Niel, mayor of Arvory, and called for unity and urged restraint from the populace.
NewsProperties.Title: Nationalist Violence

NewsProperties.Description:
Decades after the infamous Izzam Incident, new unconfirmed information emerges that challenges the official state narrative. As per anonymous former Black Battalion sources, the incident was not an act of foreign aggression to destabilize Sordland but a government conspiracy to gain influence. 

Materials related to members of the Old Guard faction revealed startling information about the involvement of high-ranking government officials in the incident some of which are in powerful positions to this day. Our paper won't be disclosing the details due to potential safety reasons.

This fresh perspective on the bloody incident of 1933 necessitates a reassessment of Sordish history, promising to reshape our understanding of the Bludish movement.
NewsProperties.Title: Unearthed: The Izzam Incident

NewsProperties.Description:
Anton Rayne promised to continue the market reforms of Ewald Alphonso but is he turning from his promise just after a few days in office? Contacts close to the government report that yesterday, Sordland’s economic policies have been planned behind closed doors. Shortly after the meeting that was also attended by President Rayne, the Ministry of Economy has released a statement regarding their short term economic plans which included the promotion of planned economy.

This must have puzzled many citizens around Sordland who had voted for Rayne because of his promises for a free market economy. Without a doubt, the people will ask their questions if no clear remarks are made by the government.
NewsProperties.Title: Promises Abandoned Already

NewsProperties.Description:
Anton Rayne promised to promote a planned economy for Sordland but is he turning from his promise just after a few days in office? Contacts close to the government report that yesterday, Sordland’s economic policies have been planned behind closed doors. Shortly after the meeting that was also attended by President Rayne, the Ministry of Economy has released a statement regarding their short term economic plans which included the promotion of a free market economy.

This must have puzzled many citizens around Sordland who had voted for Rayne because of his promises for a planned economy. Without a doubt, the people will ask their questions if no clear remarks are made by the government.
NewsProperties.Title: Promises Abandoned Already

NewsProperties.Description:
Unfazed by recent political developments, Gasom is set to bolster Sordland's infrastructure and support its ongoing development efforts. As one of Sordland's largest corporations, Gasom's financial aid, logistical support, and equipment aid are crucial to Sordland's economic resurgence. The support provided by the corporation, whose roots are intertwined with our nation's own, exemplifies the corporation's dedication to Sordland's prosperity.

- This advertisement was sponsored by the Alphonso Foundation. -
NewsProperties.Title: Fueling Sordland's Tomorrow

NewsProperties.Description:
The rector of the HSU Sander Navek reported that a fire broke out in the archives of the university academic administration building causing damage to scientific and other types of documents. The Emerald hospital reported that five wounded people are being taken care of but in stable condition.

After the fire was put out by firefighters, the Sordish Intelligence Directorate cordoned the scene in suspicion of foreign subversive interference. Several academicians including Herman Equa have stepped forward with concern regarding the status of many famous academic papers and recognitions stored in the archives.

Equa was quoted saying “Our great quests of knowledge should have been protected better.”.
NewsProperties.Title: Suspicious Fire Ravaged HSU

NewsProperties.Description:
President Rayne gave signals about a cooperation with Frens Ricter of the PFJP and Kesaro Kibener of NFP ahead of the inauguration ball. Regarding the remarks of Ricter about a possible cooperation to fix the current problems of Sordish political institutions, ‘’We want the other parties to join him in this endeavor.’’ said President Rayne.

Ricter has long been vocal about his democratization plans, but maybe his demands for constitutional change might finally become a reality if President Rayne leads a bill together with Ricter’s PFJP.
NewsProperties.Title: Rayne Calls For Cooperation

NewsProperties.Description:
President Rayne shut down the call for cooperation from Frens Ricter of the PFJP ahead of the inauguration ball. Regarding the remarks of Ricter about a possible cooperation to fix the current problems of Sordish political institutions, the President said that he doesn’t think he 'shares the same values' with him.

Ricter has long been vocal about his democratization plans, and it seems that his demands for constitutional change will never become a reality if we do not see a Ricter Presidency any time soon. It looks like the opposition will have a hard time during President Rayne’s term.
NewsProperties.Title: Rayne Shares No Values With Ricter

NewsProperties.Description:
President Rayne shut down the call for cooperation from Frens Ricter of the PFJP ahead of the inauguration ball, implying that he shares no values with the opposition. Regarding the remarks of Ricter about a possible cooperation to fix the current problems of Sordish political institutions, the President chose to make no comments.

Ricter has long been vocal about his democratization plans, and it seems that his demands for constitutional change will never become a reality if we do not see a Ricter Presidency any time soon. It looks like the opposition will have a hard time during President Rayne’s term.
NewsProperties.Title: Rayne Not Interested In Cooperation

NewsProperties.Description:
President Rayne signalled a possible cooperation with Frens Ricter of the PFJP ahead of the inauguration ball. Regarding the remarks of Ricter about a possible cooperation to fix the current problems of Sordish political institutions, the President chose to make no comments.

Ricter has long been vocal about his democratization plans, but maybe his demands for constitutional change might finally become a reality if President Rayne leads a bill together with Ricter’s PFJP.
NewsProperties.Title: Rayne Open To Talk

NewsProperties.Description:
President Rayne shut down the call for cooperation from Frens Ricter of the PFJP ahead of the inauguration ball. Regarding the remarks of Ricter about a possible cooperation to fix the current problems of Sordish political institutions, ‘’I don’t expect much from him.’’ said President Rayne.

Ricter has long been vocal about his democratization plans, and it seems that his demands for constitutional change will never become a reality if we do not see a Ricter Presidency any time soon. It looks like the opposition will have a hard time during President Rayne’s term.
NewsProperties.Title: Rayne Doesn’t Expect Much from Ricter

NewsProperties.Description:
One of President Rayne’s first acts in office was to sign a campaign finance law allocating public election funds by number of Assembly seats, as opposed to the percentage of votes won in the general election.

In an interview ahead of his inauguration ball, Rayne claimed that this decision, which would effectively double the election budget for his own party, was necessary in order for the USP to “truly bring democracy” to Sordland.
NewsProperties.Title: Rayne Says Bill Was Necessary For Democracy

NewsProperties.Description:
President Rayne shut down the call for cooperation from Frens Ricter of the PFJP ahead of the inauguration ball. Regarding the remarks of Ricter about a possible cooperation to fix the current problems of Sordish political institutions, 'We will do our job, no matter what,' said President Rayne.

Ricter has long been vocal about his democratization plans, and it seems that his demands for constitutional change will never become a reality if we do not see a Ricter Presidency any time soon. It looks like the opposition will have a hard time during President Rayne’s term.
NewsProperties.Title: Rayne Shuts Down Ricter

NewsProperties.Description:
One of President Rayne’s first acts in office was to sign a campaign finance law allocating public election funds by number of Assembly seats, as opposed to the percentage of votes won in the general election.

In an interview ahead of his inauguration ball, Rayne admitted this was a deliberate strike against the Workers’ Party of Bludia and the Communist Party of Sordland, neither of which would be eligible for funding under the new law. Both parties would “only make trouble” if allowed to grow unchecked, he claimed.
NewsProperties.Title: Rayne Denigrates Small Parties with Bill

NewsProperties.Description:
President Rayne gave signals about a cooperation with Frens Ricter of the PFJP ahead of the inauguration ball. Regarding the remarks of Ricter about a possible cooperation to fix the current problems of Sordish political institutions, 'I welcome it. This is a challenge for us all.' said President Rayne.

Ricter has long been vocal about his democratization plans, but maybe his demands for constitutional change might finally become a reality if President Rayne leads a bill together with Ricter’s PFJP.
NewsProperties.Title: Rayne Welcomes Ricter’s Words

NewsProperties.Description: The first and most important modern entrepreneur Sordland has ever seen has sadly passed away today. People looked up to Konrath Koronti as a figure of success, respect and wealth. After his immediate passing, his son Marcel Koronti took over his title as the new CEO of the Heart of Sordland Conglomerate.
NewsProperties.Title: Konrath Koronti Passed Away

NewsProperties.Description: Contacts close to the government report that yesterday, Sordland’s economic policies have been planned behind closed doors. Shortly after the meeting that was also attended by President Rayne, the Ministry of Economy has released a statement regarding their short term economic plans which included the promotion of a free market economy.
NewsProperties.Title: Economy Meeting Held in Holsord

NewsProperties.Description:
Sordland has been shocked by grave news today as an elected member of parliament has been shot dead in a suspected political assassination. Police sirens were heard around the clock today as the Holsord Police Force increased security measures around the capital.

The fact that such a violent act happened at the heart of the capital during the new President’s inauguration celebrations has worried many citizens. The Red Youth has reported to have promised revenge. This seems like it has the potential to be a spark that would swirl Sordland into the political violence of the 1920’s.
NewsProperties.Title: MP Shot! Nation In Shock

NewsProperties.Description: Contacts close to the government report that yesterday, Sordland’s economic policies have been planned behind closed doors. Shortly after the meeting that was also attended by President Rayne, the Ministry of Economy has released a statement regarding their short term economic plans which included the promotion of planned economy.
NewsProperties.Title: Economy Meeting Held in Holsord

NewsProperties.Description:
The new President has been sworn into office by the Chief Justice Orso Hawker. Another great win for the USP and Anton Rayne, who managed to get 37% of the general vote.

The first congratulations came from Kesaro Kibener of the National Front Party, which finished third in the electoral race and entered the Assembly. The runner up of the general vote, the PFJP, didn't concede until the last minute, but the results were clear since several hours in.

Thousands of supporters have gathered in the streets of Deyr chanting campaign slogans, waving flags and displaying USP party banners to display unwavering support to the newly elected president. The public mood is very positive in the city from all accounts on the ground. The city is celebrating that a Deyr-born President with humble roots is now sitting in the Maroon Palace.
NewsProperties.Title: President Anton Rayne

NewsProperties.Description:
The new President has been sworn into office by the Chief Justice Orso Hawker. Another great win for the USP and Anton Rayne, who managed to get 37% of the general vote.

The first congratulations came from Kesaro Kibener of the National Front Party, which finished third in the electoral race and entered the Assembly. The runner up of the general vote, the PFJP, didn't concede until the last minute, but the results were clear since several hours in.

Thousands of supporters have gathered in the streets of Holsord chanting campaign slogans, waving flags and displaying USP party banners to display unwavering support to the newly elected president. The public mood is very positive in the capital from all accounts on the ground. The city is celebrating that a Holsordian has become the President of Sordland.
NewsProperties.Title: President Anton Rayne

NewsProperties.Description:
Sordland’s economy has been displaying a downward trend over the past two years of Alphonso’s presidency. If we want to prevent our country from declaring bankruptcy, we need a way out of this recession and we need it now!

The economic downturn keeps hitting hard at the businesses which are struggling to stay afloat, it is clear that a helping hand from the government is required to control the situation. There is no other way apart from bailing out businesses to truly provide relief to the economy. This in turn should revitalize the economy by creating more employment opportunities and increasing production in Sordland.
NewsProperties.Title: The Only Way Out of Recession: Bailing Out Businesses

NewsProperties.Description:
The government has made an excellent move to push for economic relief for businesses. The bailout is saving thousands and thousands of jobs and softening the economic blow.

The genius move led by President Rayne will play out very well in the years to come. The administration must focus on boosting employment to make sure the working-class have food security and shelter in a time where their livelihoods are threatened.

Some National Business Council members have already come out with positive messages and there have been positive statistics released by the Central Bank as a result of the bailout. Sordland is racing towards growth and recovery if the government continues on this path.
NewsProperties.Title: Businesses are Alive and Well

NewsProperties.Description:
The hallowed halls of the Grand National Assembly of Sordland were recently alive with spirited debates concerning the Energy Protection Act  of 1932. Frens Ricter of the People's Freedom and Justice Party and Independent MP Mansoun Leke tabled a proposal to repeal the EPA, currently restricting foreign ownership of security-sensitive energy corporations to 20%. This is a significant move as it brings to the fore the crucial issue of market openness and foreign investment. 

This repeal, we believe, can catalyze economic growth and bring Foreign Direct Investment to a market long-protected from international competition. The old guard must embrace the changing global economic order, or risk lagging behind.
NewsProperties.Title: Calling for an Open Market: Repealing the EPA

NewsProperties.Description:
The government has made its decision to promote a planned economy, a decision which is based on flawed arguments of Sollonomics.

The Ekonomists believe in the free-market economy for good reason. Now before anybody calls us Arcasia sympathisers, we don't support the excessive form of capitalism Arcasia is spreading around the world like in Lespia. Our belief is that a balance can exist where the government can support the private sector with government money.

Businesses could take the needed economic planning burden off the shoulder of the government. We disagree with a planned economy simply because you can't properly micromanage everything in a society where people need to be able to determine their own future. The Sordish people don’t deserve to be shackled and it is sad to know that President Rayne doesn’t think the same way.
NewsProperties.Title: The Wrong Economy

NewsProperties.Description:
Amidst ongoing geopolitical uncertainties, there's an economic imperative that we can't ignore; the potential of our northern neighbor, Rumburg. Known for its vast energy economy and is home to two major corporations: Rizias Rizian Oil and Gas (ROG) and Royal Emerald Energy (REE), both ripe for collaboration.

These energy giants represent not just the possibility of wealth generation, but also a means of diplomatic softening, aligning mutual interests to avoid future conflicts. By welcoming partnerships, we ensure that globalisation serves as a bridge, not a barrier.
NewsProperties.Title: Cooperation with Rumburg – an Economic Imperative

NewsProperties.Description:
Underhall Construction was once again picked as the #1 construction company of the year by the reputable Statistics Sordland. This was the 11th time the company was selected for the top spot in a row since Kris Schar was appointed as the CEO.

Veteran industry leader, Schar, congratulated the employees first and foremost in a private company meeting held in a luxurious resort in Erlory. He also mentioned the recent addition of Heart of Sordland Organisation CEO, Marcel Koronti to the Board of Advisors helped immensely in this great achievement.

At The Ekonomists we think now is a great time to invest in Underhall Construction as the current year's projection already shows a 13% increase in growth compared to the last year.
NewsProperties.Title: Underhall Construction Once Again #1

NewsProperties.Description:
The administration has fallen for populism and the idea that giving people money will solve the problems of the economy overall. It is hard to grasp where these ideas come from especially when long-term job growth and employment is what this country needs to secure in order to have a stable economy.

What is the plan here? People will be able to pay their rents for a few months and then they will fall into the same unemployment trap due to a lack of job availability or security. The businesses can’t carry all the weight of the declining economy on their own shoulders and employ people without help from the government.

The administration needs to reevaluate their way out of the recession with realistic methods.
NewsProperties.Title: Unemployment and Cheques

NewsProperties.Description:
The Contanan Security Pact’s Iyotake Plan—an ambitious initiative to transform Rika's infrastructure and education sectors—has drawn mixed reactions globally. Western Merkopa and Northern Xina view the plan with skepticism, framing it as a geopolitical maneuver tied to ideological rivalries. Rika, however, has welcomed the proposal, seeing it as an opportunity for economic growth. Anraka and Yarktralis have cautioned against the plan, concerned it could further intensify superpower competition.

Rooted in principles of sustainable decentralized economic development, the Iyotake Plan seeks to empower local communities and foster equitable growth by prioritizing education and infrastructure. While the plan aligns with Internationalist economic theory through its emphasis on localized decision-making and resilience, its reception varies across nations, reflecting differing priorities and concerns.
NewsProperties.Title: Iyotake Plan: A Global Perspective

NewsProperties.Description:
In a recent development, LesPower, the largest energy corporation of the ATO member Lespia, announced an energy deal with Pales over the disputed sea gas field Aureus. Rizia, which has laid claims over these fields, is likely to see an escalation in tensions. The Alliance of Nations, through its mechanism ANDOR, has been closely monitoring the situation, attempting to defuse the issue diplomatically. 

As energy resources become a major bargaining chip, this event adds another layer of complexity to regional politics.
NewsProperties.Title: Energy Tensions Escalate in Rizia

NewsProperties.Description:
Rumburg has closed down its consulate in Sordland, one of the few east Merkopan nations to have diplomatic ties with the northern kingdom. This comes right after the deployment of Rumburgian troops near the northern borders of Sordland.

Rumburgian officials cite 'political unrest and uncertainty' as the main reason for the closure while raising concerns over security in the country.

In Lachaven, a diplomatic source said the Rumburgian flag has been lowered overnight and that the diplomatic staff were expected to leave Sordland on Friday or Saturday. Many Lachaveners were shocked as the 120-year-old Rumburg Consulate closed. Dozens of citizens with Rumburgian relatives went out to protest against this action in the afternoon.

It was not clear if the consulate closure was temporary or permanent, signalling a break in diplomatic ties which date from 1923. Our editors see this situation as a further deterioration of relations between Sordland and Rumburg. This can be easily regarded as a one-sided provocation from the North.
NewsProperties.Title: Rumburg Closes Consulate

NewsProperties.Description:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade reacted swiftly to the Rumburg Consulate closure in Lachaven by shutting down the Sordland Consulate in Dome, an Agnolian city annexed by Rumburg. This clear retaliatory diplomatic response will draw a lot of attention in the global diplomatic stage but was welcomed by PM Maartin Van Hoorten of Agnolia.

President Rayne seems to be decisive against Rumburg, but whether this will be worth it is another question.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Closes Consulate

NewsProperties.Description:
The response to the Rumburg Consulate closure in Lachaven was quick. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs sent a strongly worded official diplomatic condemnation letter, accusing Rumburg of destabilizing Sordland and the surrounding region. Several nations have made supporting statements for Sordland in the Alliance of Nations.

It is clear that this letter is not just directed at Rumburg, but to all surrounding countries observing the serious situation.
NewsProperties.Title: Sordland Condemns Closure

NewsProperties.Description:
Troubling news are coming from the Mayor of Anrica who reported that a state of chaos exists in the city, and called an emergency directive, authorising him to use his security powers.

In an announcement Mayor Leste said, 'We are reporting twenty police officers heavily wounded, two police stations burned down and several shot, the city is in a state of emergency and we are trying to restore order'. The local Gendarmerie began assisting the mayor after the emergency request was made, the armed units are now securing critical junctions and key infrastructure like power stations, hospitals and the municipality building.

Local NFP leaders have announced that they will assist the local enforcement with the task of keeping the streets safe by reporting violent dissenters, a statement criticised by the local PFJP official.
NewsProperties.Title: Emergency in Anrica, Mayor Announces!

NewsProperties.Description:
Huge crowds of mourners, including President Rayne and other senior Sordish officials joined under a rare display of unity, poured into the heart of Deyr today to bid farewell to Bernard Circas, the poet and politician who was shot and killed at the gates of the Maroon Palace after Rayne’s Inauguration ball.

With hundreds of police officers in riot gear on duty and traffic barred on major thoroughfares, the normally chaotic section of the city took on a somber atmosphere. Malenyevist anthems played from loudspeakers along Freedom Avenue as Sordish citizens of various ethnicities stood shoulder to shoulder, many of them in tears. Others leaned out windows or over balcony railings to watch the procession.
NewsProperties.Title: President Attends Funeral

NewsProperties.Description:
A significant development unfolded in the Grand National Assembly as the process to repeal the Energy Protection Act of 1932 was initiated. This Act, presently restricting foreign ownership of security-sensitive energy corporations to 20%, is now under threat. Vocal advocates Frens Ricter of the PFJP and USP reformist-wing leader Albin Clavin argue that repeal could stimulate economic growth and foreign investment. 

However, opposition from the United Sordland Party and National Front Party remains, protecting Sordish strategic industries from foreign control. The decision now awaits next month's crucial vote.
NewsProperties.Title: Energy Protection Act Repeal Process Begins

NewsProperties.Description:
Huge crowds of mourners, including President Rayne and other senior Sordish officials joined under a rare display of unity, poured into the heart of Deyr today to bid farewell to Bernard Circas, the poet and politician who was shot and killed at the gates of the Maroon Palace after Rayne’s Inauguration ball.

With hundreds of police officers in riot gear on duty and traffic barred on major thoroughfares, the normally chaotic section of the city took on a somber atmosphere. Malenyevist anthems played from loudspeakers along Freedom Avenue as Sordish citizens of various ethnicities stood shoulder to shoulder, many of them in tears. Others leaned out windows or over balcony railings to watch the procession.

President Rayne gave a unifying message to all of Sordland by attending the funeral. He paid his respects to Circas and met with his close relatives. Rayne also made an emotional speech that touched thousands of attendees.
